description.narrative: Global environmental challenges are of great concern to the international community. These issues are inherently multidimensional and fall under the various subsets of environmental, economic and social issues. The interconnectedness of these issues makes it a challenge to mitigate them. Individual institutions such as most of the bodies, funds, programmes and specialized agencies of the United Nations System are each established with their own mandates and limited jurisdiction. Thus, making the actions taken and policies developed on environmental related matter within the system, independent from the decision-making processes and activities of other organizations dealing with the similar matters. To effectively achieve the sustainable development goals and tackle significant environmental issues such as biodiversity loss, pollution and climate change, it is imperative that efforts are taken to enhance effective collaboration in the handling of environmental and environment related matters within the UN system. It is crucial to develop a holistic and integrated approach that mitigates these fundamental environmental issues in the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. By encouraging the engagement of the UN system in joint action on addressing the triple planetary crisis, promoting an understanding of how the environment links to other areas of work, facilitating system-wide approaches on the environment, and guiding coherent actions and enabling partnerships across all sectors and agencies, the project serves as a valuable and established tool for UNEP. The project is in line with UNEP’s PoW 2022-2023 in increasing the level of cooperation and coherence in the United Nations system in mainstreaming and delivering on the environmental dimensions of the 2030 Agenda; and in integrating environmental sustainability, including climate, biodiversity and pollution considerations, into all functions of the UN. As a multi-stakeholder and multi-sectoral convener (since 2001), the EMG is well positioned to mobilize UN system-wide participation in discussions on, and contribution to, addressing key global challenges, thus promoting the integration of environmental issues within the policies, programs and management of the United Nations system and its coherence in the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The EMG’s activities contribute directly to the implementation of UNEP’s strategic objective “towards a pollution-free planet” and support the UN Reforms by helping UN entities deliver on their mandates in a transparent, coherent and efficient manner, building on each other’s comparative advantage. The project responds primarily to the Sub Porgramme Environmental Governance. It aligns with Expected Accomplishment (a) of the UN Environment Programme of Work, by promoting "common and integrated approach to achieve the environmental objectives and implement the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development". The project also directly contributes to the achievement of Outcome 2 of Executive Direction and Management as well as its indicators: (i) and (ii). Furthermore, the project contributes directly to the achievement of the Environmental Governance subprogramme indicators: (iii) and (iv). Through the management of issue-focused working groups, the project will contribute to the implementation of the three Thematic Programmes through the following Direct Outcomes in the Medium-Term Strategy 2022-2025: Climate action - 1.2; Nature action - 2.1, 2.9; and Chemicals and pollution action - 3.3 and 3.10. The EMG project is linked to Sustainable Development Goal 17 and its target 17.14 to enhance policy coherence for sustainable development. The project will deliver on three Outputs: enhancing support to Member States in advancing the environmental dimension of the SDGs, internal sustainability of the UN System, and setting the annual interagency agenda on the environment. The project Activities will target several causes of the core problem: Lack of integrated approaches and coherence in UN system support to Member States in the implementation of the environmental dimension of the SDGs.
